description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在培養英語演講技巧，此為課堂上與工作中都會用到的重要能力。課程將著重於個人的溝通技巧，提升組織、邏輯推理及聽講能力。每位學生須練習不同目的之演講，並參與同儕互評且提供建議。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed to develop public speaking skills. Public speaking is a vital soft skill- be it used in the classroom or for a presentation at work. Attention will also be given to individual communication activities designed to improve the ability to organize, reason critically, and to listen effectively. Each student will develop and deliver several speeches and participate in peer evaluations.

targets.describe_ch: 能辨認並評估具有社會重要性的主題，並針對這些主題做口頭報告。
targets.describe_en: Identify and assess socially significant topics, and then deliver oral presentations on these topics.

targets.describe_ch: 能在口語溝通時，分析談話內容。
targets.describe_en: Engage in critical listening and speaking.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. 平時考核 In-class evaluation 50%
2. 期中演說 Midterm exam: Persuasive speech 25% 
3. 期末演說 Final exam: Informative speech 25%
Notes: 
1. No make-up presentations or exams are accepted except emergency or reasonable cases, in which official documents are required. If make-up presentations or exams are allowed, please contact me for arrangement.
2. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant official documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 同意請假 ≠ 同意補考
3. According to Article 26, Paragraph 2 of the university's Academic Regulations, make-up exam scores may be recorded as the actual score only if the student's leave of absence falls under the officially approved reasons. If not, the score will be reduced to 80%.
